description: Generator 'Genny' (Yanmar) fuel line leaked three times at the same location despite two repairs. A non-OEM replacement tube was weathered and too stiff to survive engine vibration.
response: Crew switched to generators Bambi and Rachel while a softer hab-sourced tube was used for the repair. Genny returned to service.
lesson: Bring OEM-spec fuel line tubing for each generator model. Never use aftermarket tubing as a permanent fix in Arctic conditions.
